newsitem.title: UK: CU sees 23 pct growth in new business. [CORRECTED 13:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CU sees 23 pct growth in new business. [CORRECTED 13:00 GMT]

text.p: UK insurance group Commercial Union Plc said on Wednesday that its worldwide new business in life assurance, pensions and investments had increased by 23 percent to 2.215 billion stg in the first nine months of 1996.
The group also said new annual premiums grew by 31 percent to 193 million stg over the period.
"It is pleasing that further good progress continues to be made by our operations worldwide," John Carter, CU's chief executive, said in a statement.

"This good performance reflects the growth in new business achieved by our substantial operations in the UK, France and the Netherlands together with the continued development of our newer operations, particularly in Poland and Italy," he added.
New single premiums were 15 percent higher at 1.81 billion stg, while sales of investment products grew to 212 million stg, compared with 87 million stg in 1995.
